quantitative_overrides.fin_note: Operating ROIC normalized to 28.11% (reaching 31.98% in FY25) reflecting high capital efficiency from direct distribution, superior underwriting algorithms, and float dynamics. Forward 5-10Y compound growth of 7.5% is supported by private motor policy volume growth (2.0%), inflation tariff indexation (3.0%), household/travel/loan diversification (1.5%), and capital return/special dividends (1.0%). Strong Solvency II coverage (~193%) and >40x interest coverage.
